sources.label: Steam 商店完整 AI 披露
sources.excerpt: Some images on the store page are generated using AI tools to create initial concept art, which are then manually adjusted and modified by artists. The final works combine AI-generated foundational designs with human artistic revisions.

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Geo Seed Games，发行商 Luckycalf）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 41），首页主题集中在登录报错，没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（AI Transparency Index 逐字复刻商店披露的分析页，其内容仍是披露的转录而非独立核实）。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作核查时尚未发售（商店页标注 Coming soon）。披露只说明商店页图片，未说明游戏内素材是否使用 AI，因此 art 领域按“披露未说明”处理。
disclosureQuote: Some images on the store page are generated using AI tools to create initial concept art, which are then manually adjusted and modified by artists. The final works combine AI-generated foundational designs with human artistic revisions.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-31 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: An open world survival crafting game about collecting and transforming into creatures. The developer states that some store page images were generated with AI tools as initial concept art and then manually adjusted and modified by artists, combining AI foundations with human revisions.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Geo Seed Games, publisher Luckycalf) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 41), whose topics concern login errors rather than AI use; individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read; the AI Transparency Index page reproduces the store disclosure verbatim and is not independent verification. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The game had not been released at review time (the store page lists Coming soon). The disclosure is limited to store page images and does not say whether in-game assets used AI, so the art area is recorded as not addressed.
